question: Why must the essential Kaula teaching originating from the yoginīs not be given indiscriminately?
premises: The Kaula essence must not be given
It is identified as the essence of the yoginīs
It is described as their origin or source
inference: The sacred Kaula essence, originating from the yoginīs, is restricted from indiscriminate transmission.
uncertainties: sambhavam may function appositionally despite case difference.
plain_english: The Kaula essence, the origin belonging to the yoginīs, must not be given.
